documentation.content:
**What it means.** The citrus-api Cloud Run service in northamerica-northeast1 returned ten or more 5xx responses in a five-minute window. The API has no error tracker of its own (Sentry is web-only), so this is the server-side error signal. Discovery failing on every call (2026-09-16) would have tripped this within a minute of the first manager opening a draft room.

**What to do.**
1. `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="citrus-api" AND httpRequest.status>=500' --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --freshness=15m --limit=20 --format='value(timestamp,httpRequest.status,httpRequest.requestUrl)'` - which routes.
2. `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="citrus-api" AND severity>=ERROR' --project=citrus-fantasy-prod --freshness=15m --limit=20 --format=json | jq -r '.[] | .jsonPayload.message // .jsonPayload.event // .textPayload'` - why.
3. If it started with a deploy: `gcloud run services update-traffic citrus-api --region=northamerica-northeast1 --to-revisions=<previous>=100`.

Managed by `infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-uptime.sh` (`alert-api-5xx.json`).

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name = "citrus-api" AND metric.label.response_code_class = "5xx"
